summary: The ElevenLabs free plan includes 10,000 credits per month, roughly 10 minutes of audio, with access to the core text-to-speech voices. Credits reset monthly and no credit card is required.
claim_steps: Open elevenlabs.io/pricing and choose the Free plan.
Sign up for a free ElevenLabs account.
Confirm your email to unlock the 10k monthly credits.
Generate speech from the Playground or API within the free quota.

social_proof.title: ElevenLabs Pricing for Creators & Businesses of All Sizes
social_proof.text: Explore all subscription plans and find which one is right for you. Choose from a range of individual, professional and enterprise tiers.
